speed_limit.notes: v8: fore-aft probe baseline 1.0 m, matching the confirmed terrain-grade scale. Preserve the old slow-down slope 0.12/0.84=1/7 (8.13 deg), so steep_rise=(2*0.5)/7. Retain 0.28 m/s stair speed and 0.8 m/s maximum: the user confirmed traversability, not faster speed. This is a slow-down trigger, not a capability limit.

terrain.notes: User 2026-11-16 confirmed official M1 loco stair mode traverses a 0.28 m riser (A-trail maximum measured 0.27707 m) and 47 degree grade over 1 m. support_mask fits a plane on a 1 m diameter disc of known median-filtered heights, matching mapping grade_radius_m=0.5; no direct replacement of the former one-cell 35 degree derivative. Independent 8-neighbour and two-cell discontinuity checks reject >0.28 m edges. Collision threshold = 0.28+0.02 m ground noise, same as mapping body-band lower bound. Unknown cells remain unsupported. This changes observations and speed triggers; v7 evaluation/training numbers are a different environment version.

v2.notes: Measured highest known 3x3 ground excludes terrain faces, matching the fixed mapping geometry band: 0.22 m = original 0.20 m step + 0.02 m range/ground noise. The separate own-ground collision cutoff remains terrain.collision_height=0.30 m. Effective reference = max(own ground, neighbourhood max - (collision_height - terrain_face_height)); obstacle = max(0, measured top - reference). Do not increase the fixed face cutoff with locomotion capability: an adjacent stair must not hide a short pole. Neighbourhood is one BEV cell (0.125 m) each way, the nearest available online scale to mapping's 0.1 m 3x3 neighbourhood. No ground opening in v2; use the existing known-only 3x3 support median once for the ground channel, obstacle reference and support, so isolated high low-returns cannot lift the reference. Unseen cells never supply ground. Memory stores a whole (absolute low return, absolute top return, acquisition time) tuple per world cell; latest delivered acquisition wins. observation_delay delays measurements in world coordinates, never the final body image. v1 retains its original pipeline.

notes.distance_scale_std: per-episode distance scale 1+N(0,0.02): leg/wheel odometry on rough ground drifts 2-5% of distance, lidar(-inertial) odometry 0.5-2%; 2% for the fused estimate
notes.heading_walk_std: heading random walk, rad per sqrt(m): 1 sigma 1.1 deg after 100 m, 3.1 deg over the 728 m trail, i.e. gyro-aided leg odometry fused with lidar odometry (about 1 deg per 100 m)
notes.imu_std: white noise on each 5 Hz pitch/roll reading, rad (0.57 deg): MEMS AHRS attitude error under legged-gait vibration
notes.distance_unit: state slot 0 = odometry distance / 1000 m, so the 728 m trail reads about 0.73
notes.plane_grid: footprint points (along, across) of the least-squares ground plane for the true pitch/roll
